activity-date.narrative: BOL 5 is one of the largest and most recognized network of 22 CSOs in the country and the only network that brings together the main women's and feminist organisations. BOL 5 project is focusing and violence, exclusion and racism against womend . GBV in Bolivia is link to poverty and exclusion affecting in particular rural women (the femicide rate in Bolivia is one of the highest in Latin America). With an intersectional approach and through a network of 22 organizations using advocacy, communication and mobilization strategies, BOL 5 intends to have a national and local/municipal impact at the same time. In this sense, BOL 5 has the best conditions to meet the objective of the project and to channel resources to its member organizations. The intervention focuses on addressing violence, exclusion, and racism against women, with BOL 5 leveraging its network to reach economically disadvantaged and rural women who might otherwise be difficult to access if BOL 5 were to implement the intervention independently. 2024 was the first year of RFSU supporting BOL 5.
